channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Python Workers Reach GA on Cloudflare, with Questions About Cold Starts and Upstream Maintenance
item.description: Cloudflare has made Python Workers generally available, built on PEP 783 and on socket syscalls implemented over the Workers connect API. The announcement carries no performance figures. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Cloudflare Worker Previews: Per-Branch Environments for Workers
item.description: Cloudflare has introduced Worker Previews. This feature allows each Git branch to have its own isolated, production-like environment for a Worker. Each environment has a stable URL. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 now available on AWS
item.description: AWS now offers Claude Sonnet 5.5, a smarter and more efficient Sonnet that delivers a clear leap forward on coding and knowledge work with at a lower cost per task for most work at faster speed. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Grok 4.7 is now available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.7, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, with US Geo and Global cross-Region inference. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 Future-dated Capacity Reservations Now Supports Postponing Start Dates
item.description: Amazon EC2 Future-dated Capacity Reservations let you secure capacity up to 120 days in advance by specifying the capacity you need, the start date, and a commitment duration. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports retryable writes
item.description: For developers building MongoDB-compatible applications, retryable writes improve application resilience during transient errors such as network interruptions or primary failovers. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Rekognition Face Liveness now returns Feedback Codes
item.description: Amazon Rekognition Face Liveness now returns Feedback Codes that help customers understand why a liveness check received a low score and how users could retry successfully. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Corretto September 2026 Patch Updates
